platform and in manufacturing we have three products, three verticals, I would say.

number three is manufacturing of accessories. So all these three product lines have started 
contributing to our revenue and the platform what we are building in terms of the distribution, 
in terms of the network of service centers.

keeps on expanding. And third segment is accessories.

three more products. So what we have seen is that accessories also complement the sale of 
profiles or the solar structures or the processed metal and it is sold through the same distribution 
channel.
